 Seth Rogen says Madonna gives a ‘great performance’ in “The Studio” season 2, teases ‘very meta’ role is key to plot
 Joey Nolfi 2026년 11월 16일 월 오후 4:46 UTC 0 Madonna and Seth Rogen at 2026 MTV VMAsCredit: Paramount+ Key Points
 Seth Rogen says Madonna does “very meta” work in The Studio season 2.
 Rogen notes the pop icon gives a “great performance” in the upcoming season that will surprise fans.
 Entertainment Weekly previously reported that Madonna filmed scenes in Venice, Italy, where she also made her “Like a Virgin” music video in 1984.
 Seth Rogen has stoked even more fan excitement over Madonna ’s upcoming role in The Studio season 2.
 After Entertainment Weekly reported earlier this year that the Queen of Pop would return to acting with her first live-action role in 24 years at the center of The Studio ’s second season, Rogen revealed on the Happy Sad Confused podcast (below) that Madonna’s work will stun fans.
 “To me, the show is hard to make. Physically. We do a lot of takes, we’re running around, we’re on our feet a lot,” Rogen said of helming episodes for season 2 of the Apple TV project, which was partially shot in Venice, Italy — the same place Madonna previously filmed her 1984 “Like a Virgin” music video.
 Seth Rogen in ‘The Studio’Credit: Apple TV+ Rogen said that “as long as someone works hard, I am a fan of theirs — and, not surprisingly, Madonna is the hardest-working person I’ve ever met in my entire life” to date.
 “She was dedicated to really delivering a great performance and to playing our game as well, and to handing herself over to our process,” said the star, before teasing “the storyline she’s involved in” across forthcoming episodes.
 Rogen called it “really wonderful and very meta in a lot of ways,” and that it’s “something that we had a vision of this idea and it required Madonna to be a part of it, or else a big chunk of our season potentially wasn’t going to work.”
 Advertisement
 He called the process of hinging a season around her was a “very scary” part of the process.
 Fellow Studio star Bryan Cranston also recently opened up about Madonna ’s role in the season, telling Access Hollywood in May that he does “something in front of Madonna in a truth-or-dare test, and it’s a dare” that “will either raise my street cred very high or destroy my career.”
 The Studio season 2 marks Madonna’s first live-action acting role in a scripted project since she led the cast of Swept Away , the 2002 movie directed by her ex-husband, Guy Ritchie.
 She was spotted on set with Julia Garner , the Emmy-winning Ozark actress who was previously cast to play Madonna in the pop star’s self-directed, long-delayed biopic — and who has appeared on stage with Madonna during the Celebration world tour, in her Confessions II short film , and on stage at the MTV VMAS in September .
 Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter . 
 Rogen also made a guest appearance during Madonna’s MTV VMAs performance, briefly joining the legend during a performance of “Danceteria” alongside Charli XCX, Madonna’s longtime friend Debi Mazar, and even Madonna’s ex-boyfriend, model Tony Ward .
